They are observing a wall display featuring circular plates of various food items, such as soups and noodle dishes. (2) The camera zooms in as the toddler in the pink dress points her right hand toward a specific bowl of soup on the wall, which appears to be a meatball soup. A woman's hand briefly enters the frame, pointing as well. Yellow subtitles and variety-show style captions appear at the bottom. (3) The scene shifts to a cooking workshop setting. A young girl is now wearing a yellow chef's hat and a matching yellow apron with oversized sleeves. She is holding a large, shiny metal bowl filled with puffed rice grains. Other children in red and yellow aprons are partially visible in the background. (4) The girl in the yellow apron is seen at a workstation, using a large wooden spoon to stir the puffed rice in the metal bowl. An adult's hands assist her by tilting the bowl. The lighting is warm and bright, typical of a studio or classroom. (5) In a different cut, the toddler from the first phase is sitting at a wooden table, holding two metal spatulas up to her cheeks like fans, looking curiously toward the camera. (6) Returning to the DIY activity, the girl in the yellow chef outfit presses down on the rice mixture with her hands, assisted by an adult. (7) The final sequence shows the toddler in the pink dress happily eating pieces of the puffed rice snack at a table. She picks up a grain, puts it in her mouth, and smiles with squinted eyes. The video ends with a pink screen showing a cartoon character and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
